reset_reference: one canonical reset per seed; assert scene metadata, physical state and all three camera pixels match for all six arms
sampling: same policy RNG seed per scene and per inference call across all arms; record explicit noise fingerprints without extra draws; prefix comparisons only after early success
selection: lowest equally weighted NL/ID loss on fixed 64 validation frames among saved steps 500,1000,1500,2000,2500; earliest tie; report pretrained score separately; no test-based selection
stratification: single/two door from reset fixture and relevant door joints, before examining outcomes; retain all consecutive seeds regardless of scene mix
preservation: new exclusive outputs/phase2/evaluation-v1; never reuse Phase1D aggregates
limitation: CloseFridge instruction robustness only; no claim of preserving all other pretrained tasks; original pretraining overlap unknown
